$schema: iLaunchify Certificate Type catalog v1 — used by C1 seed importer
notes: Curated master library of 179 cert types (89 original + 90 US/CA additions on 2026-07-05) with categories/markets/claims/alternatives. Used as seed input by `pnpm --filter @ilaunchify/db prisma db seed`. Edit by appending; do NOT remove existing slugs without an admin migration plan (PartnerCertificateInstance rows reference slug).

certs.name: USDA Organic
certs.applicabilityNotes: Gold standard for organic in US. Annual re-inspection required.

certs.name: CCOF Organic
certs.applicabilityNotes: USDA-accredited California-based organic certifier.

certs.name: Oregon Tilth Certified Organic (OTCO)
certs.applicabilityNotes: USDA-accredited certifier with strong sustainability emphasis.

certs.name: QAI Organic
certs.applicabilityNotes: USDA-accredited; widely used by manufacturers.

certs.name: Pennsylvania Certified Organic
certs.applicabilityNotes: Northeast regional USDA-accredited certifier.

certs.name: EU Organic (Euroleaf)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Required for products sold as organic in EU. US-EU organic equivalence exists for many product types.

certs.name: Canada Organic Regime
certs.applicabilityNotes: Required for products labeled organic in Canada.

certs.name: Non-GMO Project Verified
certs.applicabilityNotes: The North American non-GMO standard. Annual re-verification.

certs.name: Non-GMO Verified by NSF
certs.applicabilityNotes: NSF alternative to Non-GMO Project.

certs.name: Kosher (OU)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Most widely recognized kosher mark globally.

certs.name: Kosher (OK)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Major kosher certifier; alternative to OU.

certs.name: Kosher (Star-K)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Baltimore-based kosher certifier.

certs.name: Kosher (Kof-K)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Major kosher certifier.

certs.name: Kosher (CRC)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Chicago-area kosher certifier.

certs.name: Halal (IFANCA)
certs.issuingBody: Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America
certs.applicabilityNotes: Most widely recognized halal certifier in North America.

certs.name: Halal (HFA UK)
certs.applicabilityNotes: UK-based halal certification body.

certs.name: Halal (JAKIM Malaysia)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Globally accepted halal mark, especially in Asia/Middle East exports.

certs.name: Certified Vegan (Vegan Action)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Most widely recognized vegan trademark in North America.

certs.name: V-Label
certs.applicabilityNotes: European vegan/vegetarian label; common across EU retailers.

certs.name: Vegan Society Trademark
certs.applicabilityNotes: Oldest vegan trademark globally.

certs.name: Fair Trade USA
certs.applicabilityNotes: Major fair trade certifier; coffee/chocolate/sugar/produce.

certs.name: Fairtrade International (FLO)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Global Fairtrade mark.

certs.name: Fair for Life
certs.applicabilityNotes: Comprehensive fair trade + social responsibility cert.

certs.name: Rainforest Alliance Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Sustainability + farmer welfare; common on coffee + chocolate.

certs.name: Bird Friendly Coffee
certs.applicabilityNotes: Shade-grown coffee preserving migratory bird habitat. Coffee only.

certs.name: Gluten-Free Certification (GFCO)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Most stringent gluten-free standard (10ppm vs FDA's 20ppm).

certs.name: NSF Gluten-Free Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: NSF alternative to GFCO.

certs.name: Whole30 Approved
certs.applicabilityNotes: Compliance with Whole30 diet rules — no sugar, grains, legumes, dairy, alcohol.

certs.name: Certified Paleo (Paleo Foundation)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Paleo diet compliance.

certs.name: Keto Certified (Paleo Foundation)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Macro requirements for ketogenic diet products.

certs.name: cGMP — Current Good Manufacturing Practice (Food)
certs.applicabilityNotes: 21 CFR Part 117. Facility-level — auto-attach to every product.

certs.name: cGMP — Current Good Manufacturing Practice (Supplements)
certs.applicabilityNotes: 21 CFR Part 111. Facility-level supplement-specific cGMP.

certs.name: SQF Level 1 — Food Safety Fundamentals
certs.applicabilityNotes: GFSI-benchmarked. Entry-level SQF.

certs.name: SQF Level 2 — Certified Food Safety Plans
certs.applicabilityNotes: Most-common SQF level for mid-large manufacturers.

certs.name: SQF Level 3 — Comprehensive Food Safety and Quality
certs.applicabilityNotes: Highest SQF level. Includes quality management beyond safety.

certs.name: BRC Global Standard for Food Safety
certs.applicabilityNotes: GFSI-benchmarked UK-origin standard, globally common.

certs.name: IFS Food
certs.applicabilityNotes: GFSI-benchmarked; common in EU retail supply.

certs.name: FSSC 22000
certs.applicabilityNotes: GFSI-benchmarked. ISO 22000 + sector PRP.

certs.name: ISO 22000 — Food Safety Management
certs.applicabilityNotes: ISO standard for food safety management systems.

certs.name: HACCP — Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points
certs.applicabilityNotes: Foundational food safety methodology; required by FDA for juice, seafood.

certs.name: PrimusGFS
certs.applicabilityNotes: GFSI-benchmarked; common in fresh produce.

certs.name: USP Verified Dietary Supplement
certs.applicabilityNotes: Gold standard for supplement quality + purity verification.

certs.name: NSF Certified for Sport
certs.applicabilityNotes: Banned substances testing for athletes. MLB / NFL recognized.

certs.name: NSF/ANSI 173 — Dietary Supplements
certs.applicabilityNotes: Standard for supplements — ingredient + label accuracy.

certs.name: Informed Sport
certs.applicabilityNotes: Batch-by-batch banned substance testing.

certs.name: Informed Choice
certs.applicabilityNotes: Less frequent testing than Informed Sport. Same body.

certs.name: BSCG — Banned Substances Control Group
certs.applicabilityNotes: Banned substances testing across all athletics levels.

certs.name: ConsumerLab Approved
certs.applicabilityNotes: Independent supplement testing + recommendation.

certs.name: MoCRA Compliant
certs.applicabilityNotes: Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act 2022 compliance. Effectively required for US cosmetics.

certs.name: COSMOS Organic (ECOCERT)
certs.applicabilityNotes: International organic cosmetic standard.

certs.name: COSMOS Natural (ECOCERT)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Natural-but-not-organic cosmetic standard.

certs.name: NATRUE — Natural and Organic Cosmetics
certs.applicabilityNotes: European natural + organic cosmetics label.

certs.name: Soil Association COSMOS
certs.applicabilityNotes: UK-based COSMOS implementation.

certs.name: NPA Natural Personal Care
certs.applicabilityNotes: US natural cosmetics standard.

certs.name: Made Safe
certs.applicabilityNotes: Screens against ~6,500 known toxic substances.

certs.name: EWG Verified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Toxin avoidance + transparency. Famous Skin Deep database.

certs.name: Leaping Bunny
certs.applicabilityNotes: Globally recognized cruelty-free mark. Company-level scope.

certs.name: PETA Beauty Without Bunnies
certs.applicabilityNotes: PETA's cruelty-free certification.

certs.name: AllergyCertified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Cosmetic allergen screening for sensitive skin.

certs.name: AAFCO Statement
certs.issuingBody: Association of American Feed Control Officials
certs.applicabilityNotes: Required for US pet food nutritional adequacy claims.

certs.name: NASC — National Animal Supplement Council Quality Seal
certs.applicabilityNotes: Quality + transparency for pet supplements. Company-level.

certs.name: Pet Food Institute Member
certs.applicabilityNotes: Industry membership signaling commitment to pet food standards.

certs.name: FEDIAF — European Pet Food Industry
certs.applicabilityNotes: EU pet food industry standard.

certs.name: Global Animal Partnership
certs.applicabilityNotes: 5-step animal welfare standard, Whole Foods recognized.

certs.name: Clean Label Project Purity Award
certs.applicabilityNotes: Tests for heavy metals + contaminants in baby food + supplements.

certs.name: EWG Verified for Kids
certs.applicabilityNotes: EWG standard scoped to children-specific products.

certs.name: B Corp Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Company-level certification of social + environmental performance.

certs.name: The Climate Label (formerly Climate Neutral Certified)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Measures, reduces, offsets all Scope 1-3 carbon emissions. Annual renewal.

certs.name: 1% for the Planet Member
certs.applicabilityNotes: Pledges 1% of annual revenue to environmental causes.

certs.name: CarbonFree Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Carbon offset certification for products.

certs.name: Plastic Negative Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Removes more plastic than the company produces.

certs.name: SBTi Validated — Science Based Targets
certs.applicabilityNotes: Validates company emissions targets align with Paris Agreement.

certs.name: BPI Compostable
certs.applicabilityNotes: Packaging compostability. Often paired with non-packaging certs.

certs.name: Cradle to Cradle Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Comprehensive product sustainability + circular economy.

certs.name: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Sustainable forestry. Common on tea + packaging.

certs.name: Marine Stewardship Council (MSC)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Sustainable wild-caught seafood.

certs.name: Aquaculture Stewardship Council (ASC)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Sustainable farmed seafood.

certs.name: American Heart Association Heart-Check
certs.applicabilityNotes: Nutrition standard for heart-healthy foods.

certs.name: USDA BioPreferred
certs.applicabilityNotes: Biobased product content certification.

certs.name: Carbon Trust Standard
certs.applicabilityNotes: UK-origin carbon footprint reduction certification.

certs.name: Gluten-Free Society Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Stricter than GFCO — 5ppm threshold.

certs.name: Certified Gluten-Free (Allergen Control Group)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Canadian gluten-free standard.

certs.name: Nut Free Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Facility-level guarantee against nut cross-contamination.

certs.name: Plastic Free Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Plastic-free packaging verification.

certs.name: Upcycled Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Verifies food made from rescued/upcycled ingredients.

certs.name: Regenerative Organic Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Higher bar than USDA Organic — soil, welfare, fairness.

certs.name: Demeter Biodynamic
certs.applicabilityNotes: Biodynamic agriculture standard — beyond organic.

certs.name: Halal-Certified Supplements
certs.applicabilityNotes: Halal certification for dietary supplements specifically.

certs.name: WSAVA Compliant Pet Nutrition
certs.applicabilityNotes: Veterinary nutrition guidelines compliance for pet food.

certs.name: Whole Grain Stamp
certs.applicabilityNotes: WGC membership + Stamp Agreement + per-product registration (>=8g whole grain/serving). Bilingual Canadian stamp exists. Artwork GATED (member area).

certs.name: American Grassfed Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Third-party inspection at least every 15 months. Logo restricted to AGA-certified producers/approved products. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Humane Raised and Handled
certs.applicabilityNotes: Farm + processing chain audited to HFAC species standards; seal use approved by HFAC. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Animal Welfare Approved by AGW
certs.applicabilityNotes: Annual farm audit; every label bearing the mark pre-approved by AGW. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Grassfed by AGW
certs.applicabilityNotes: Requires AWA base certification + 100% grass/forage audit + AGW label approval. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Non-GMO by AGW
certs.applicabilityNotes: AGW non-GMO audit + label pre-approval. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Regenerative by AGW
certs.applicabilityNotes: Audited whole-farm regenerative plan + AGW label approval. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: American Humane Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Third-party audit against AHS species welfare standards + licensing agreement. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Naturally Grown
certs.applicabilityNotes: Peer-review certification; packaged goods only when majority of ingredients by volume are CNG. Artwork GATED (provided to members).

certs.name: Real Organic Project
certs.applicabilityNotes: Add-on to USDA Organic (soil-grown/pasture-raised). Artwork FREE-OFFICIAL: logo zip + PNGs on Use-The-Label page.

certs.name: Glyphosate Residue Free
certs.applicabilityNotes: Per-SKU lab testing below glyphosate detection threshold + trademark license. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: WSDA Organic
certs.issuingBody: Washington State Department of Agriculture Organic Program
certs.applicabilityNotes: WSDA-certified ops; labels pre-approved (WAC 16-157); WSDA logo not larger than USDA seal. Artwork FREE-OFFICIAL on Organic Labels page.

certs.name: MOSA Certified Organic
certs.applicabilityNotes: MOSA-certified ops; every SKU label approved; not larger than USDA seal. Artwork FREE-OFFICIAL: PNG+EPS on logos-usage page.

certs.name: Land to Market (EOV Verified)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Member brands sourcing from farms passing Ecological Outcome Verification. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Regenified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Source from farms certified to 6-3-4 standard + mark license; USDA FSIS-accepted on inspected products. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Plant Based
certs.applicabilityNotes: NSF review against CPB protocol (zero animal-derived ingredients) + $100/product license (waived for PBFA members). Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Monash University Low FODMAP Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Lab-tested below Monash low-FODMAP cut-offs + license agreement. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: FODMAP Friendly
certs.applicabilityNotes: Independent FODMAP testing in accredited lab + current logo license. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: True Source Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Hive-to-table honey traceability + authenticity testing + third-party audit. Artwork GATED (certified members).

certs.name: Certified Angus Beef brand
certs.issuingBody: Certified Angus Beef LLC (American Angus Association)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Licensed brand program (USDA-graded to 10 carcass specs), not an independent third-party cert. Artwork GATED (licensed-partner dashboard).

certs.name: Real California Milk
certs.applicabilityNotes: Made in California with 100% California milk by a CMAB-authorized processor. Artwork GATED (license).

certs.name: BeVeg Vegan Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: ISO 17065-accredited vegan standard audit (incl. on-site) + trademark license. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: GGN Label (GLOBALG.A.P. consumer mark)
certs.applicabilityNotes: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA cert + GRASP + 13-digit GGN number + label license. NOTE: the B2B GLOBALG.A.P. mark itself is NOT for retail packs. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Sourced from BAP star-rated certified facilities + logo-use rules. Artwork GATED (certified clients).

certs.name: Ocean Wise Seafood Recommended
certs.applicabilityNotes: NOT a certification (their own wording: recommendation program); symbol licensed to current partners only; pre-2022 logos prohibited. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Friend of the Sea
certs.applicabilityNotes: Third-party audit against FOTS standard + signed logo-license agreement. Common on fish-oil supplements. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Salmon-Safe
certs.applicabilityNotes: Site certification (US Pacific Northwest + BC); labeling terms per license. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Bee Better Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Product Seal (majority ingredients) or Ingredients Seal (>=1) from Bee Better farms + Xerces license. Licensing in-house since 2026. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: EFI Responsibly Grown, Farmworker Assured
certs.applicabilityNotes: Grower operation holds current EFI certification. Artwork GATED (certified operations).

certs.name: USDA Process Verified Program (PVP) shield
certs.applicabilityNotes: AMS-approved PVP; verified process points printed adjacent to shield; FSIS label approval for meat/poultry. Artwork GATED (approved PVP holders).

certs.name: Kosher (KSA)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Registered KSA mark only on products under active supervision contract. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher (EarthKosher)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Trademark use requires active EarthKosher certification agreement. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher (Scroll K)
certs.issuingBody: Scroll K / Vaad Hakashrus of Denver
certs.applicabilityNotes: USPTO reg. 5057939; symbol only under current Scroll K supervision. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher (MK)
certs.issuingBody: Jewish Community Council of Montreal / Montreal Kosher
certs.applicabilityNotes: MK hechsher licensed per-product under active certification contract. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher (COR)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Canada's largest kosher agency (~70,000 products); mark restricted to products on a current COR certificate. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher Check
certs.issuingBody: Orthodox Rabbinical Council of British Columbia
certs.applicabilityNotes: Formerly BC Kosher; symbol licensed while ORC-BC certification is active. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher Dairy (Star-D)
certs.issuingBody: National Council of Young Israel (administered by STAR-K)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Registered TM applied by STAR-K to qualifying certified dairy (non-cholov-yisroel) products. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Kosher (Triangle K)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Symbol only under active rabbinical supervision contract. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (HMA Canada)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Whole-supply-chain inspection; logo only under current HMA certification. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (ISNA Canada)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Mark licensed per certified product/facility for certificate validity period. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (AHF)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Symbol use bound to certificate scope; verifiable in AHF certificate database. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (ISWA)
certs.issuingBody: USA Halal Chamber of Commerce / ISWA Halal Certification Department
certs.applicabilityNotes: Written permission required for every label use; mark valid only for certified products during certificate period. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (HFSAA)
certs.issuingBody: Halal Food Standards Alliance of America
certs.applicabilityNotes: Logo restricted to entities on the published certified-entities list. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (Halal Transactions of Omaha)
certs.applicabilityNotes: ISO 17065-accredited; mark limited to certified products/scope. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Halal (HMCA)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Mark licensed on certification; covers food, cosmetics, health products. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: VegeCert Certified Vegan / Vegetarian
certs.applicabilityNotes: Two designations (vegan/vegetarian); symbol after inspection + contract. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Aliments du Quebec
certs.applicabilityNotes: Provincial origin: >=85% Quebec ingredients + Quebec processing; Bio variant adds >=95% organic. Logos via member portal after per-product certification. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Foodland Ontario
certs.applicabilityNotes: Free program but logo file sent only after signed logo agreement; product must meet Ontario food definitions. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Natural Product Number (NPN)
certs.applicabilityNotes: REGULATORY LICENSE, NO MARK: mandatory 8-digit 'NPN' text on every natural health product label in Canada; no seal/artwork exists. Model as text-only label element.

certs.name: IFOS Certified (fish oil)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Per-SKU certification with ongoing lot testing. Artwork GATED (licensed to certified clients).

certs.name: IGEN Non-GMO Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Two tiers (Tested vs Certified w/ traceability); mark licensed to enrolled products only. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: IPRO Probiotic Certification
certs.applicabilityNotes: CFU/identity/contaminant testing per lot; mark tied to active certification. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: NPA GMP Certification
certs.applicabilityNotes: Facility-scoped third-party GMP audit; seal cannot imply product-level testing. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: NSF/ANSI 455-2 GMP (Dietary Supplements)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Facility audit certification (455-3 covers cosmetics GMP); mark must reference facility/GMP scope, not product content. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: UL Verified Mark (Marketing Claim Verification)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Claim verified via facility audit + product testing; mark must carry unique ID resolvable on verify.ul.com. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Labdoor Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Badge licensed commercially after passing testing (testing data public regardless). Artwork GATED.

certs.name: ISURA Certification
certs.applicabilityNotes: 800+ contaminant panel + label integrity (ISO 17025 lab). CAVEAT: closely associated with Natural Factors/Assured Natural. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified C.L.E.A.N.
certs.applicabilityNotes: Composite score >=80 (safety/organic/non-GMO/bioavailability). CAVEAT: founder-driven niche org — admin review before enabling. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: NEA Seal of Acceptance
certs.applicabilityNotes: HRIPT/CIT/SIU testing + no exclusion-list ingredients + fully fragrance-free; every use pre-approved by NEA. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Skin Cancer Foundation Seal of Recommendation
certs.applicabilityNotes: $15k/yr Corporate Council membership + Photobiology Committee approval (SPF 30 daily / SPF 50 active). Redesigned seal rolling out 2026. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: EPA Safer Choice
certs.applicabilityNotes: All ingredients meet Safer Choice criteria; 3-year partnership agreement + audits; label artwork provided under partnership. Mostly cleaning, narrow personal-care coverage. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Green Seal Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: GS-44 rinse-off / GS-50 leave-on personal care; USPTO-registered mark, prior written approval required. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: UL ECOLOGO
certs.applicabilityNotes: ISO Type 1 ecolabel (Canadian origin); lifecycle standard audit by UL; mostly soaps/sanitizers. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: SkinSAFE 100 / Trusted Choice
certs.applicabilityNotes: Built on Mayo Clinic allergen data; verified free of top-allergen list; commercial brand agreement required. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: SFI On-Product Label
certs.applicabilityNotes: Packaging fiber: valid SFI CoC certificate + label-use authorization via SFI Office of Label Use; pre-press approval + label ID. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: PEFC Label
certs.applicabilityNotes: Packaging fiber: PEFC CoC cert + Trademarks Usage Licence; labels only from official generator (EPS/PDF/PNG) with licensee number. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: How2Recycle Label
certs.applicabilityNotes: Paid membership + per-SKU packaging recyclability assessment; artwork proof approval; US + Canada versions. Artwork GATED (member portal).

certs.name: How2Compost Label
certs.applicabilityNotes: Requires How2Recycle membership AND BPI compostability certification of the package. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: OK compost INDUSTRIAL / HOME
certs.applicabilityNotes: Conformity mark must include holder's S-code, unmodified; use on non-certified products prosecuted. Artwork GATED (certificate holders).

certs.name: CMA Certified Compostable
certs.applicabilityNotes: ASTM D6400/D6868 + fluorine limit + field disintegration test; logo license + fee separate. NOTE: 'CMA Accepted' is NOT a certification. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: SCS Recycled Content Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Annual audit to SCS-103 verifying recycled %; claim must state certified %. Kingfisher mark for certified clients only. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Green-e Certified (Marketplace logo)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Renewable-energy purchase matching qualifying % of electricity use + Marketplace license. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: CarbonNeutral Certification (product)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Annual certification to the CarbonNeutral Protocol; only product-class certs may put logo on packaging. Artwork GATED (approval required).

certs.name: Plastic Bank Certified Plastic Neutral
certs.applicabilityNotes: Ongoing plastic-collection credits equal to plastic footprint. CAVEAT: self-administered, not ISO-accredited third-party. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Wildlife Friendly
certs.applicabilityNotes: Certification against CWF Global Products Guidelines; species marks (Elephant Friendly Tea etc.). Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Green America Certified Business
certs.applicabilityNotes: Certified dues-current members; seal on packaging/tags but NEVER directly on product; cannot imply product safety/quality. Artwork: public zip on seal page, legally member-restricted.

certs.name: Women Owned Logo (WBENC/WEConnect)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Certified WBEs (>=51% women owned/operated/controlled) in good standing; built for retail packaging. Artwork GATED (WBENCLink2.0 / WEConnect).

certs.name: Certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Active NMSDC certification required; logo rights end when certification lapses (moving to Credly digital badges). Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified LGBT Business Enterprise (LGBTBE)
certs.applicabilityNotes: >=51% LGBTQ+ owned/operated/controlled + current NGLCC certification. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Disability-Owned Business Enterprise (DOBE)
certs.applicabilityNotes: >=51% owned/controlled by person with disability; valid 3 years. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Veteran-Owned Business (NaVOBA)
certs.applicabilityNotes: Certified VBE/SDVBE (>=51% veteran owned/operated/controlled); explicit on-product-label program. Artwork GATED (request form).

certs.name: Certified Evergreen
certs.applicabilityNotes: Third-party Evergreen 7Ps assessment; mark licensed to certified companies. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: PSC Accreditation
certs.applicabilityNotes: PSC membership + third-party impact assessment meeting minimum verified score. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: One Health Certified
certs.applicabilityNotes: Annual USDA-verified audit against public species standards (animal protein). Seal licensed to audited participants. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: Certified Indigenous Business (CIB)
certs.applicabilityNotes: >=51% Indigenous owned + controlled + CCIB membership. Formerly CCAB Certified Aboriginal Business. Artwork GATED (member portal).

certs.name: CAMSC Certified Supplier
certs.issuingBody: Canadian Aboriginal and Minority Supplier Council
certs.applicabilityNotes: >=51% Aboriginal or visible-minority owned/managed/controlled; recertification required. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: WBE Canada Certified / Canadian Women Brand
certs.applicabilityNotes: >=51% women owned/managed/controlled Canadian firms; Canadian Women Brand is the consumer-facing mark. Artwork GATED (Toolbox).

certs.name: Certified 2SLGBTQI+ Business
certs.applicabilityNotes: >=51% LGBTQ+ owned/operated/controlled Canadian for-profit. Use new CQCC branding, not legacy CGLCC. Artwork GATED.

certs.name: IWSCC Certified Veteran/Disability-Owned
certs.issuingBody: Inclusive Workplace and Supply Council of Canada
certs.applicabilityNotes: Veteran- or disability-owned diverse supplier certification. Artwork UNVERIFIED — treat as GATED.

certs.name: Made in USA Brand Certification Mark
certs.applicabilityNotes: Paid license ($250-$2,000/yr); must meet FTC US-origin standard; Self-Certified tier must disclose. CAUTION: 2014 FTC enforcement action against this company — admin review before enabling. Artwork GATED.
